_about: Round 4 VIRAL: the callouts (Callouts, scripts/ui/callouts.gd) and the clash moment (BendClash, scripts/bending/bend_clash.gd). Big short words on the player's own screen, centred above the strip, never on or over anyone. One at a time: a higher priority one takes over, lower ones wait (at most queue_n, dropped after stale_s).
_team_self_only: A team format (2v2, 4v4): only the player's own moments are called out (a splash: a fall he dealt or took), never a team-mate's or another bot's; last_life stays for everyone. false: the who rules below as in a 1v1.
_look: The look: font size, outline, the screen height of its middle (anchor_y, 0 top .. 1 bottom), the scale punch (from punch to 1 over punch_s, overshoot), the tilt (deg), the fade over its last fade_s.
_colors: The element colours (the one whose moment it is), and the colour of a moment of no one's (the last life).
_calls: Each callout: its word, priority (higher first) and whose moments show it (mine: the player's side only; any: either side). ignited: a gas cloud lit (the skill tree's Ignited Sulphur, a reaction: worn matter only, so Classic never calls it; BendGas.ignite).
_clash: A clash (two attacks meeting): a two-colour burst of each element's bits (n each, size, speed m/s, spread deg), a flash and two shockwave rings standing in the air at the meeting point (life s, scale from .. to), a light, one sound ([id, gain dB, pitch]: the clash id when the sounds have one, else the loudest hit), and a shared hold of both casters' poses through BendImpact when it is there (hold_s).
